contentText:
Ariana Grande’s song “Petal” debuts in the Hot 100’s top 10, while Ella Langley and Morgan Wallen continue to see huge success this week.

Tetris Kelly: Where did Ariana’s new music land on the chart? This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated Aug. 15. “Be Her” slips to 10, as does “So Easy” to No. 9. “Dracula” to No. 8, and Ella and Morgan Wallen to seven. “Boston” is down a spot to No. 6, and Taylor Swift to No. 5. Ariana Grande debuts “Petal” at four. Morgan’s “Been By Now” falls to three, with “Hate That I Made You Love Me” shooting up to two. So grabbing a 17th week at No. 1 is “Choosin’ Texas.”
